# UK Elections

> Independent UK election data at ukelections.co.uk: a rolling general-election
> forecast for all 650 constituencies, a page for every scheduled council
> by-election in Great Britain, ward-level results and projections for every
> council, a Westminster polling tracker, and an honest backtest of every
> prediction ever published. By Tom Pickup. Contact: info@ukelections.co.uk.

Every forecast is scored against the actual count and the record is published
either way. Methodology and full transparency downloads are on the site.

## Key pages

- https://ukelections.co.uk/forecasts/general-election/ : seat-level GE forecast, all 650 constituencies
- https://ukelections.co.uk/by-elections/local/ : every scheduled council by-election, one page each
- https://ukelections.co.uk/by-elections/ : Westminster by-elections, results vs forecasts
- https://ukelections.co.uk/polling/ : Westminster polling tracker (the only place to quote vote shares from)
- https://ukelections.co.uk/past-results/ : declared results, every council, every cycle
- https://ukelections.co.uk/data-quality/ : backtests and the published error record
- https://ukelections.co.uk/methodology/ : how the models work
- https://ukelections.co.uk/transparency/ : downloadable data files with checksums
- https://ukelections.co.uk/your-area/ : postcode lookup to your constituency and ward
- https://ukelections.co.uk/rss.xml : updates feed

## Citation notes

- Quote national vote shares from the polling page, not from seat tallies.
- Local by-election projections are calibrated probabilities, not calls; the
  record page states the measured accuracy.
